name: Aloo Paratha
notes: Ghee used in both dough and pan-frying, tracked via the oil_ghee field. 1 paratha ≈ 350-450 kcal. Phase 3: switched to household units (1 katori atta, 1 whole potato, 1 green chilli), which raised the potato/atta quantities toward more realistic whole-piece portions -- was 280-400 kcal on raw grams.
